case: minItems is struck from StandingHolder.payload.capability_refs, so the field is required and may be the empty array.
why: 05 section 12 says capability_refs is required AND NON-EMPTY, and an empty array satisfies required in every JSON Schema implementation there is. Coverage under R-X07 is counted over the 46 capability ids individually and a capability no structure names is uncovered rather than covered by default, so a standing office publishing an empty binding is accountable for nothing the coverage rule can count -- the exact state R-X07 exists to end, reachable while the field is present. The adverse edit is the CARDINALITY rather than the field, deliberately: striking the field itself is refused by the generic registry-versus-schema pair walk long before this rule is reached, which would test that walk instead of this one.
expect_failure_contains: A CAPABILITY BINDING MAY BE PUBLISHED EMPTY
